doc: CallScreenshot asks the frontend to capture its current render state. It is meant as a feedback channel for automated agents (e.g. an LLM operating the UI on behalf of the user) and is answered with a [RetScreenshot].

1.doc: Keep is kept to avoid falling back to the zero value which breaks polymorphism at protocol level.
1.name: Keep

2.doc: Selector is an optional CSS selector restricting the capture to the first matching element. Empty means the whole page.
2.name: Selector

4.doc: Snapshot requests a textual accessibility snapshot of the rendered DOM, similar to the aria snapshot of Playwright.
4.name: Snapshot

5.doc: MaxEdge limits the longest edge of the PNG in pixels. Zero means the frontend default.
5.name: MaxEdge
